mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing prednisone metabolism and systemic exposure, while prednisone may increase clarithromycin levels; additive immunosuppression also occurs.
action: Monitor for increased prednisone effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, hypertension) and clarithromycin toxicity; consider alternative antibiotic if high-dose prednisone is required.
